rows.what_the_ink_shows: In crops/121_scan028_L974_hypotheses.jpg Proposition D takes Y to be a topological manifold purely of dimension i and N to be a topological space; no PL qualification is written. In crops/121_scan028_L974_equivalence.jpg, after a cancelled earlier formulation, the active statement begins Si nu >= i and uses ssi between the mobility of (y,n) and the (nu-i)-mobility of n. The displayed consequence is the equality Y_nu(Y times N) = Y times Y_{nu-i}(N), not a one-sided inclusion. These active assertions and the cancellations agree with the original source.
rows.note: Written: under nu >= i, the author states both directions of the mobility equivalence for the topological spaces specified, and then the corresponding equality. Retain the equivalence and equality. The proposed mathematical assessment, quoted verbatim from the row, is: "'<=' holds; '=>' fails in TOP (R x cH is a 5-manifold, the cone point a of cH is immobile; double suspension theorem); expected to hold in PL (intrinsic stratification, from memory)". The direction claim, double-suspension counterexample, and expectation in PL are carried as unproved background. No counterexample re-derivation, verification of the double suspension theorem, or intrinsic-stratification argument was performed in this visual review. The supplied Michel Hua project remark is a mathematical lead rather than evidence that the active handwritten ssi should be transcribed differently.
